ft.step1: Patient sits facing the camera and raises both hands beside the shoulders, thumb and index finger of each hand touching.
ft.step2: Tap thumb and index finger together on both hands at the same time, opening as wide and tapping as fast as possible.
ft.step3: Keep tapping until the recording stops by itself (15 s).

ftf.step1: Patient sits facing the camera with both index fingers pointing to the ceiling.
ftf.step2: Bring the two index fingertips together out in front of the chest, then point them to the ceiling again.
ftf.step3: Repeat until the recording stops by itself (15 s).

fr.step1: Patient sits facing the camera, gently clenches both hands and holds the forearms horizontally in front of the chest.
fr.step2: Roll the hands around each other as fast as possible.
fr.step3: Keep rolling until the recording stops by itself (15 s).

saw.step1: Patient sits on the chair at the start mark, side-on to the camera.
saw.step2: Stand up and walk to the turn mark (15 ft / 4.6 m), turn and walk back.
saw.step3: Keep walking back and forth until the recording stops by itself (45 s).

fa.step1: Patient looks at the camera and keeps the head still.
fa.step2: Lift the eyebrows as high as possible, make a big smile, then relax the face.
fa.step3: Do it all once more: eyebrows up, big smile, relax.
